symptom: Production v711 returned the same generic failure for both a Biz-only Professor question and an internal page-view question, while a cold homepage could leave both vacation availability rails in a terminal retry state.
expected_behavior: Professor returns only verified stored data, persists a successful question and decrements quota once. Both homepage availability rails keep recovering from a bounded cold or transient refresh and render verified cards without requiring a visitor click.
environment: Production v711-v712 and release/v646-four-gaps candidate on 2026-10-27

steps: Open the authenticated production Professor and ask כמה שיחות היו החודש.
Open a cold production homepage and observe the near-date and holiday availability rails until settled.
reproduction.evidence: Both unrelated Professor questions returned the same verified-data failure with unchanged quota and no history row. The user supplied a production screenshot with both homepage rails stopped at the manual retry state, while direct warm API reads later returned verified offers.

observations.observation: Professor state writes and report reads shared one Aurora-backed database object.
observations.evidence: app/api/admin/professor/route.ts passed requiredRuntimeDatabase to quota, history, report queries and the final history INSERT.

observations.observation: Two questions with different report sources failed after the authenticated page itself loaded.
observations.evidence: The exact Biz-calls and internal-page-view questions both reached the same generic catch path, quota stayed 20/20 and history stayed empty.

observations.observation: The homepage APIs recover and return verified cards, but the client stopped automatic recovery after one refreshing response.
observations.evidence: Direct production reads of home-deals, home-holidays and home-holiday-deals returned HTTP 200; pre-fix HomeLiveDeals changed to terminal error when automaticRetries reached one.

observations.observation: The v712 D1 state route returned the decremented quota and new history inside the request, but both disappeared after a document reload.
observations.evidence: Two authenticated public questions returned verified answers and reduced the displayed quota from 20 to 18; reloading the same production page restored 20/20 and an empty history.

hypotheses.mechanism: A failure in the shared Aurora-backed Professor state path, especially the final history write, suppresses an otherwise valid answer from any report source.
hypotheses.prediction: Keeping quota/history on one persistent primary database while retaining a separate reporting database with read-only fallback will allow answers to return without splitting or losing state.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Exercise two unrelated metrics, verify every quota/history read and write uses the same primary database, and require persisted quota and history after repeated production reloads.
hypotheses.result: Supported: v712 proved report answers recover but the D1 state choice did not persist across reload; the revised candidate uses one primary state source and passes the full suite. Final production persistence confirmation remains required.

hypotheses.mechanism: Both Hebrew questions are parsed incorrectly.
hypotheses.prediction: Intent tests would select an unsupported or unrelated metric.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Parse the exact questions with the deterministic Professor intent engine.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: the questions select bizCalls and pageViews respectively.

hypotheses.mechanism: Homepage supplier availability is permanently unavailable.
hypotheses.prediction: Direct endpoint reads would remain failed or empty after the cold request.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Read all three production homepage availability endpoints after the observed failure.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: all returned HTTP 200 and verified deals; the remaining defect is client recovery from the cold path.

fix.change: Keep every Professor quota and question-history read/write on one persistent primary database, route report reads separately through the reporting database with read-only fallback, and give both homepage vacation rails four bounded automatic recovery intervals for refreshing responses and transient transport failures.
fix.evidence: The 55-test focused repair suite and all 1730 repository tests pass, including explicit single-state-store Professor boundary checks and cold/transient homepage recovery guards. An independent simulated-Adir review also passed the revised no-split-brain boundary.

regression_checks.check: Focused Professor, availability, calendar, booking and visualization suite
Exact authenticated Professor answer, quota decrement and history persistence
regression_checks.evidence: v712 answered both authenticated questions correctly but failed persistence after reload. Required again on the revised frozen production candidate.

regression_checks.check: Cold desktop and mobile homepage render both verified availability rails without manual retry
regression_checks.evidence: Production v712 passed the automated desktop/mobile home audit with 20 cards in each rail, no terminal error and no overflow.

remaining_unknowns: The production worker intentionally does not expose its raw database exception.
The exact final mechanism is not closed until the same public authenticated questions retain quota and history through reload on the revised deployment.
authorization_boundary: Authorized code repair, tests, one frozen production publication and public verification. No supplier data, canonical business records, permissions, secrets, DNS or environment settings are changed.
